note: Provisions outside the authority profiles. Each figure carries its source and how far it has been checked. None has been reviewed by a registered architect or lawyer.

fire_high_rise.message_noc: At 21 m or above this is a high-rise under the Karnataka Fire Force Act, so a Fire NOC is required. SiteIQ does not size fire access: take driveway, turning and hardstanding dimensions from NBC 2016 Part 4 and the fire department.
fire_high_rise.message_band: From 15 m up to 21 m, NBC 2016 Part 4 treats the building as high-rise and the 2026 Bengaluru amendment requires NBC fire compliance. A 2011 notification set the NOC at 15 m, so confirm with the local fire station whether an NOC applies.
fire_high_rise.message_below: Below 15 m the high-rise triggers are not met. Ordinary fire and access provisions still apply.

source.title: Karnataka Fire Force (Amendment) Act 2023, section 13; NBC 2016 Part 4 clause 2.38
source.status: 21 m checked against the 2023 ordinance text; 15 m checked against NBC 2016 Part 4.

drain_buffers.measured_from: either side from the edge of the drain as per revenue records

source.title: Zonal Regulations (Amendment) Regulations 2025: lakes and drains
source.document_page: Karnataka Gazette Part IVA No. 656, pages 2-3
source.status: Read directly from the gazette copy on 2026-11-02. Supersedes the 50/25/15 m centre-line figures and any NGT figure in Bengaluru and BMR planning areas; check for later orders or litigation.

lake_buffer.message: UDD 468 leaves the lake buffer to the Karnataka Tank Conservation and Development Authority Act, measured from the lake as per revenue records. No distance is configured here: confirm the current KTCDA figure.

source.title: UDD 468 MNJ 2025(E), buffer for lakes
source.status: Read directly from the gazette copy on 2026-11-02.

environmental_clearance.message: Above 20,000 m² of built-up area (all floors, including basements and service areas) prior environmental clearance is likely under EIA Notification 2006 item 8(a). Confirm the category with SEIAA.

source.title: EIA Notification 2006, Schedule item 8(a)
source.status: Threshold taken from secondary summaries and NGT filings, not checked against the current MoEFCC text.

rera.message: RERA section 3(2)(a) exempts small projects, but regulators read the 500 m² and 8-apartment limits differently. Confirm registration with Karnataka RERA.

source.title: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act 2016, section 3(2)(a)
source.status: Limits taken from secondary commentary, which records conflicting regulator readings.

premium_far_charge.note: Estimate only: 50% of guidance value on the notional additional site area, and at least 28% of guidance value per m² of extra built area. TDR cost and other fees are not included.

source.title: Karnataka Premium FAR rules, gazette text as quoted in published search results
source.status: Read from a quoted excerpt. The gazette link has since gone dead, so confirm the current rate.
